mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_chat_conversation (user_id, title, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT c.conversation_id AS id, c.title AS title, c.update_time AS updatedAt, (SELECT content FROM tb_chat_message WHERE conversation_id = c.conversation_id ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS lastMessage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_chat_message WHERE conversation_id = c.conversation_id) AS messageCount FROM tb_chat_conversation c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.update_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_chat_conversation SET title = #{title} WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
UPDATE tb_chat_conversation SET update_time = NOW() WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
